meetings.title: 16th Meeting 2026
meetings.summary: Today's meeting was held to review the issues submitted to the committee regarding debate time allocation for the Threshold-2 Petitions submitted to the Majlis; "Petition requesting a solution, in consultation with relevant authorities, to exempt students who enrolled prior to the 2nd Amendment to the Qualifying Law Degree Programmes Regulation" and "Petition calling to discontinue the expensive health insurance scheme entitled to Members of the Parliament that is not available to the general public". After examining these issues, Holhudhoo Constituency Member Abdul Sattar Mohamed proposed that to debate in Parliament the "Petition requesting a solution, in consultation with relevant authorities, to exempt students who enrolled prior to the 2nd Amendment to the Qualifying Law Degree Programmes Regulation" which has received the threshold 2 (two) signatures mentioned in Article 257-6 (c) of the Standing Order of the Parliament, as per Article 257-13 (b), the total time of debate on the said petition shall be 1 (one) hour, and during that 1 (one) hour time shall be distributed among the Parliament Members in accordance with the procedure laid down in Article 110 (b) of the Standing Order of the Peoples Majlis. The motion was supported by Thimarafushi Constituency Member Ahmed Riyaz. The motion was passed unanimously by the members present and voting at the committee meeting. Following this, Kanditheemu Constituency Member, Ameen Faisal proposed that to debate in Parliament the "Petition calling to discontinue the expensive health insurance scheme entitled to Members of the Parliament that is not available to the general public" which has received the threshold 2 (two) signatures mentioned in Article 257-6 (c) of the Standing Order of the Peoples Majlis, as per Article 257-13 (b), the total time of debate on the said petition shall be 2 (two) hour and during that 2 (two) hour time shall be distributed among the Parliament Members in accordance with the procedure laid down in Article 110 (b) of the Standing Order of Peoples Majlis. The motion was supported by South Henveyru Constituency Member Hussain Imran Latheef. The motion was passed unanimously by the members present and voting at the committee meeting.

meetings.title: 6th Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, the committee reviewed the issues submitted to the committee. The first issue was a issue submitted by Velidhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Abbas requesting the inclusion of parents of Parliament Members in the health insurance scheme, and the inclusion of parents and children of the Parliament Members in the VIP service provided to them. After discussion, the committee highlighted that the insurance service provided to Parliament Members is provided by law, which does not include parents among the insurance providers by the state, but Parliament members can include their parents in the insurance package provided for the members by paying their own insurance premium in one lump sum. Therefore, the committee decided to inform of the same to Velidhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Abbas. In addition, the committee members discussed the request of Velidhoo Constituency Member Mohammed Abbas to include parents and children of the Parliament Members in the VIP service provided to them. After the discussion, the committee members highlighted that the VIP service provided to Parliament Members is already available to them. The second issue which was reviewed by the committee was a issue submitted by North Galolhu Constituency Member Mohamed Ibrahim requesting to involve women Members of Parliament or seek technical assistance from outside Parliament in investigating allegations of sexual harassment brought before Parliament, and to enable that this process is carried out in accordance with the Standing Order of the Parliament. Through the discussion, the committee members highlighted that it is not legally possible, however, if the complainant requests to include women members in the meeting of a committee, such arrangements have already been made under Article 151 (a) of the Standing Order of the Parliament. The committee decided to inform North Galolhu Constituency Member Mohamed Ibrahim of the same, and to inform the member, that parliament committees have the opportunity to seek technical assistance from outside Parliament in investigating cases of sexual harassment.

meetings.title: 2nd Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, firstly committee reviewed the mandate of the General-Purpose committee and discussed the working quorum and voting quorum of the committee. South Feydhoo constituency member Ibrahim Didi proposed to pass the working quorum of the committee as 4 members and voting quorum as 6 members. This was seconded by Thimarafushi constituency member Ahmed Riyaz and was passed unanimously. Next, committee discussed on how to proceed with the issue sent to review the amendments of the Standing Order of the People’s Majlis and South Feydhoo constituency member Ibrahim Didi proposed to give Secretary General, Counsel General, Speaker of the People’s Majlis and Parliamentary groups of the Majlis to send their amendments to the Standing Order by as 8 th June 2024. This was seconded by South Henveyru constituency member Hussain Imran Latheef and was passed unanimously. Lastly, committee reviewed the Proceeding of staff recruitment to the Parliamentary groups and the Majority leader of and Minority leader of People’s Majlis and decided to further review the issue in the next committee meeting.

meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, the appointment of the Committee chair and Deputy chair of the committee was scheduled as the newly elected members were allocated to the committees in the 2nd sitting of the 20th Majlis. Hulhudhoo Constituency member Mohamed Shahid’s name was proposed as the Chair of the committee by South Feydhoo Constituency member Ibrahim Didi and it was seconded by Dhuvaafaru Constituency member Mohamed Ali and Hulhudhoo Constituency member Mohamed Shahid was elected as the Committee chair by unanimous vote. Next, Holhudhoo Constituency member Abdul Sattar Mohamed’s name was proposed as the Deputy Chair of the committee by South Henveyru Constituency member Hussain Imran Latheef and was seconded by South Feydhoo Constituency member Ibrahim Didi and Holhudhoo Constituency member Abdul Sattar Mohamed was elected as the Deputy chair of the Committee by unanimous vote.
